thread:
maya: Quick ping — opened PR #2143 to tweak routing weights for quant models + lower cache TTL for cold-starts. Planning to merge in the 5pm PT window if no objections. TL;DR: shift fallback from region-bias 0.7->0.55, add short-lived TTL for prefix cache (200ms -> 50ms). Could impact egress if fallbacks fire more. Link: https://git/repo/pull/2143

tonY: @maya can you drop the perf numbers from your local canary? rough p50/p95?

maya: sure. ran a short canary against eu-west + us-west mix (70/30). results: p50 +3ms, p95 +28ms, token cost +0.6% (mostly due to extra cross-region hops). Throughput stable. CI smoke below.

deploy-bot: PR 2143 — canary results attached: latency change p50:+3ms, p95:+28ms, errors:0.1% (baseline 0.08%). See job: https://ci/reports/2143-canary

sanjay: small numbers but cost uptick is real if traffic hits fallback a lot. Do we have simulation for a heavy failover scenario?

maya: not a full simulation yet. I can run a targeted run for a 10% region outage pattern and post numbers in ~30m.

tony: please add a config flag to gate the new fallback threshold so we can toggle quickly if we see egress spike. Also add a note in the rollout doc about metrics to watch (egress, cross-region requests, kv-cache hit rate).

maya: good call. I'll add feature_flag:quant_routing_beta and a rollout section.

ken: quick nit — the TTL change is in milliseconds in the config? make sure it's clearly documented. I can eyeball the diff in a sec.

maya: yep milliseconds. snippet: ```yaml
routing: { fallback_weight: 0.55 }
cache: { prefix_ttl_ms: 50 }
feature_flags: { quant_routing_beta: true }
```

olivia: if canary sim shows <1% cost delta for normal ops and we have the flag + gating, i'm fine with merging. Ask for doc link on rollout before merge.

maya: will post an expanded rollout doc and the simulated outage numbers shortly. aiming to merge after 2 approvals + green CI.

sanjay: from the quick sim (ran 20m with synthetic 10% cross-region fail), cost went up ~2.1% and p95 added ~45ms for affected requests. If we limit fallback to 10% of traffic via routing policy, cost impact drops to ~0.4%. Suggest we ship with conservative rollout: 5% traffic then 25% after 1h.

olivia: +1 for conservative rollout. also add regression alert on cross-region egress rate and per-customer SLO errors.

maya: noted — will add alerts and feature flag. tagging @tony for the gating config review.

tony: i'll take a look in 15. if all good we can approve and hold merge until you confirm rollout doc posted. :thumbsup:

maya: thanks y'all. updating PR now, will ping when sims + doc are up. :rocket:
